value.rationale: Rank-one square-zero matrices are canonical in matrix commuting graphs. The theorem isolates a sharp dimension-four structural transition, proves exact local counts on both sides of it, and gives a natural finite-projective-geometric explanation. This is a reusable structural lemma rather than an arbitrary small computation.
